sources.label: Philippine Plumbing Code (PPC) — Regulatory Framework Overview
sources.description: The PPC is the governing document for plumbing systems in the Philippines, adopted through PD 1096 reference and administered by the Master Plumbers Association.

sources.label: PD 1096 RIRR 2004, Rule IX — Plumbing System Standards
sources.description: Sets minimum requirements for plumbing system design, materials, inspection, and testing in Philippine buildings.

sources.label: RA 1378: Plumbing Law of the Philippines — National Master Plumber Act
sources.description: Establishes the regulatory framework for the practice of master plumbing in the Philippines. Defines the scope of plumbing practice.
